name: Sezaki Issei
source: The son of the directon of Ebisu General Hospital. A man of few words who rarely shows his feelings, his skills as a surgeon are top notch. He was even named one of the "Ten Young Doctors to Challenge the Future of Surgery". However, there's a reason he's so serious about improving his skills as a surgeon...
